svg.aria-label: Two vaults. Your USDC goes into the Null Collateral Vault, which mints USDCn and earns interest by lending in DeFi. USDCn is the collateral in every market, where the Receivers' interest pays the Payers. Savers' USDCn goes into the Null Savings Vault, which lends it into the long markets, such as AAPLr | USDCn, for a second layer of interest.
